reviews_captured_by_me.text: We used Cape Cod Tileworks for purchasing tile for our new addition bathrooms, to be installed by our contractor.  They guided us to the perfect tile, both bathrooms turned out beautiful.  Later when we remodeled our kitchen, Cape Cod Tileworks installed our back splash.  Each time they made our remodeling process easier, with fabulous results. Great products and installation.

I went to Cape Cod Tileworks on a lazy Wednesday - early afternoon - with my mother to look for a tile backsplash for my mother's newly renovated kitchen.  The women working inside didn't seem to care at all about our business - one woman asked if we needed help to which we responded YES!! and she told us to walk around and look for ourselves - we found several things we liked but couldn't garner the clerk's attention again and we left without the clerk even acknowledging that we had been there.  VERY BAD EXPERIENCE - if you want help and knowledgeable know-how don't come here!

Schoolhouse Construction Inc., we have worked with Cape Cod Tileworks for many years. Owner, Lane Meehan has been a pleasure to work with  on our many kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects. Being a graduate of RISD, Lane's design knowledge and expertise on the variety of materials in her unique and beautiful shop have been extremely helpful. Tom Meehan , a 2nd generation tile installer,  technical  writer of JLC and Fine Home Building Magazine, working with him and his knowledge has been priceless.   We  highly recommend them for your tile needs.
